comments.author: mjonter
comments.body_html: are the virustotal false positives? Hit for Sabsik on Defender and virustotal is showing Wacatac and disco (common false positives in my personal experience)

comments.author: MyButtHasARash
comments.body_html: Yeah those are false positives — pretty much every PyInstaller exe gets flagged by a few vendors. Wacatac and Disco are notorious for flagging anything built with PyInstaller since the exe extracts and runs from a temp folder which looks suspicious to their heuristic/ML scanners.

comments.author: Devraccoon Senior Moderator
comments.body_html: Wacatac shows up on almost everything I’ve made that has to use an Internet protocol, so yes I would very much assume those are all false positives due to this tool connecting to the Internet in some capacity
